Enter the Alien Registration Number (A-Number, also shown as the USCIS number), which is the identifier tied to lawful permanent resident status. It is printed on the front of the Permanent Resident Card (Form I-551) as a 9-digit number, sometimes prefixed with "A"; copy it exactly and do not substitute the separate card number printed on the card. A Social Security number is a different field, used for the W-4 and payroll rather than for work authorization.
